title: EIT Analyzer Lambda V4.2.1
description: Research and teaching prototype comparing a small neural network (scikit-learn MLPRegressor) with classical filters for denoising synthetic signals. Includes benchmark and tests. The 3D view is decorative. This software is not evidence for any physical theory.
